cohort: Mother-baby dyads with last-born children (<24 months old) who practiced immediate skin-to-skin contact
finding: EIBF was high (88.8%) among mother-baby dyads with immediate skin-to-skin contact and was associated with several factors, including maternal education, wealth, region of residence, mode of delivery, place of delivery, and birth attendant.
mod_finding: Mothers who gave birth by non-caesarean section were more likely to practice EIBF.
